api_notes: Use explicit START edges, conditional path maps, compilation, and returned partial updates.
A route label is not a state-update dictionary; only conditional routing leaves a loop node.
The shared execution_config sets recursion_limit=40; this safety net is not a seven-attempt business rule.
Per-iteration local seeds and midpoint guessing are original deterministic adaptations, not a reproduction of the source output sequence.
limitations: No LLM, provider, credential access, or live tracing is required or performed by this module.
The target is synthetic state visible to the feedback node; this is not a security boundary or interactive game.
The midpoint policy finds every valid target before seven attempts, so a smaller allowed budget is used to demonstrate normal exhaustion.
Parent handles source figures, Mermaid rendering, execution screenshots, integration, and publication.
Only focused offline tests are authorized here; no Windows or service-dashboard validation is claimed.
